tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background behind every page.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, side panels, dialogs and the top navigation.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells inside a card: input fill, seat stepper, skeleton blocks, chips.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders. Decorative only, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders. Holds 3:1 on surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (labels, meta lines, hints) on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken. At least 4.5:1 on all three.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Lane green. Primary buttons, the current page in the top navigation, route markers, links and the wordmark. Readable as text on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Pressed and hover state of brand fills.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand or brand-strong fill.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows, avatar fill, secondary button fill. Brand text reads on it.

tokens.name: marking
tokens.usage: Road-marking amber. The dashed lane in a route line and one highlight per screen. A fill only, never text.

tokens.name: on-marking
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a marking fill.

tokens.name: marking-ink
tokens.usage: Amber you can read as text on surface and surface-raised: low-seat warnings such as "1 seat left".

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Scheduled rides and neutral notices. Text on info-soft, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Background of info badges and alerts.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Booked and completed. Text on success-soft, surface and surface-raised. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of success badges and alerts.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: A ride on the road, or something that needs attention soon. Text on warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of warning badges and alerts.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, cancelled rides and destructive buttons. Text on danger-soft, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of error alerts and cancelled badges.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill (destructive button).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. At least 3:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the page behind a dialog.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.sample: Share the ride you're already taking.
styles.usage: The Welcome page headline only. Steps down to 40/44 in a narrow window.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per page at most: the Find a ride headline. Steps down to 32/38 in a narrow window.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: The h1 of every other page, under the top navigation.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Large section headings, such as a results count, and the person's name on Profile.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Drivers share the seats they already have.
styles.usage: Intro paragraphs and empty-state body copy.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Pickup at the main gate, opposite the bus stop.
styles.usage: Default text, input values and place names.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Names, button labels and emphasis inside body text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, badge text and tab labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Meta lines and units. The smallest text in the app.

styles.name: time
styles.usage: Departure times on ride cards. Use tabular figures.

styles.name: fare
styles.usage: Prices on ride cards and the booking summary.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label, badge dot to text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and badges; label to input.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between cards in a list; between rows inside a card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between cards in a grid; the page gutter in a narrow window.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between form fields.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections and between a page's columns; padding of panels.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page side gutter on a laptop; padding of form cards.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Space between the top navigation and a page's content; between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Padding inside empty states and around the Welcome hero.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Bottom padding of every page; top padding of Welcome and Find a ride.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges and plate chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs and alerts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels and dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Avatars, the seat stepper and filter chips.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Only on cards you can tap, such as ride results.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Dialogs and menus that float over the page.

size.note: Fixed sizes for controls and page layout. Laptop width is the main target; every layout also works in a narrow window.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything you can click or tap.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Height of buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Height of small buttons inside cards. Pad the hit area up to tap-min.

tokens.name: topnav-h
tokens.usage: Height of the top navigation bar on every page.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Width of the content column on list, detail and dashboard pages, centred on surface.

tokens.name: form-max
tokens.usage: Width of the column for forms and confirmation pages (Add vehicle, Booking confirmed).

tokens.name: auth-max
tokens.usage: Width of the Sign in and Create account cards.

tokens.name: aside-w
tokens.usage: Preferred width of a side panel next to main content, such as the booking panel on Ride details.

tokens.name: tabbar-h
tokens.usage: Height of the bottom tab bar, used only if a phone layout is built later.

duration.note: Short and functional. Turn off with prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Press feedback and colour changes.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Sheets, alerts and toasts entering.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Every transition.
